description: This file defines the 'CampaignTracker' class, which extends 'SugarBean' and manages campaign tracking data for the SuiteCRM platform. It includes properties mapping to database fields and methods for saving data and populating additional details related to campaign tracking, such as URLs and campaign names.

classes.name: CampaignTracker
classes.description: A class handling campaign tracking data related to marketing activities, extending SugarCRM's SugarBean to facilitate database interactions and custom behaviors.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the save method to ensure the tracker URL has a proper scheme before saving.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a string summary of the tracker, typically used for display purposes.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields like campaign name and message URL based on related campaign data and admin settings.
